name: Plasma
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The official X account of @PlasmaFDN has been compromised. The attacker is posting phishing links using the X Bot UA spoofing trick—the URLs appear legitimate at first glance but redirect to a phishing site: https://vault-plasma[.]to. Do not click on any recent links or interact with the account until an official statement is released.
